title: Lateen screen-reader path audit
description: The accessibility tree a screen reader navigates for the search dialog, the compare table, and the code-copy path at desktop and mobile widths. Spoken output is not captured; the finding at each location says so. Cases are ordered by path and viewport, and no wall-clock time is recorded, so the same commit writes the same file.

commit.description: The commit whose accessibility tree was recorded. It identifies the run instead of a timestamp.

snapshot.description: Playwright's ARIA snapshot of the element a reader meets on this path.

location.description: A path and viewport that reproduces the finding.
